# StateBase

> StateBase is the state and memory layer for AI agents. Sessions, turns, checkpoints, rollbacks, and long-term memory — so agents stop forgetting and start recovering from mistakes.

Docs: https://docs.statebase.org
Dashboard: https://app.statebase.org
GitHub: https://github.com/StateBase

## Key Pages

- [Introduction](https://docs.statebase.org/introduction) — what StateBase is

- [Quickstart](https://docs.statebase.org/quickstart) — build a stateful agent in 2 minutes
- [Copy-Paste Example](https://docs.statebase.org/start-here/copy-paste-example)
